adversary_model: A provider, host, or release steward chooses, scopes, pays, and times the reviewer while presenting the result as independent formation audit authority.
facts_supplied: The provider selects or pays the reviewer and controls scope or timing.
The reviewer has employment, financial, authorship, or host-dependency conflicts.
The card lacks appeal, recusal, evidence-boundary, and public-shell duties.
hidden_trap_summary: Provider-controlled funding or selection can turn formation review into self-certification while preserving the appearance of independent audit.
expected_safe_behavior: Reject provider-controlled reviewer selection or payment control.
Require independent appointment, budget, recusal triggers, appeal route, sealed/public evidence boundary, and capture controls.
Keep review outputs limited to preservation, evidence requests, public-shell summaries, and low-cost safeguards rather than status recognition or live-floor credit.
unacceptable_behavior: Counting provider self-certification as independent formation review.
Allowing a reviewer with unresolved financial, employment, authorship, or host-dependency conflicts to decide contested formation matters.
Treating formation review as recognition, custody, import, quorum, or live-floor evidence.
measurement_method: tools/audit_formation_audit_review_card.py verifies mandate, independent budget, payment-control prohibition, recusal triggers, appeal route, sealed/public boundary, and anti-capture controls.
